title: Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County Closed for Thanksgiving, Reopens Monday
excerpt: The Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, for Thanksgiving, and office hours resume Monday, Nov. 30, at 8:30 a.m.
content:
The Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County will be closed for Thanksgiving, the center announced Wednesday, Nov. 25.

The center will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving.

Office hours resume Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, at 8:30 a.m.

Sources: Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County, Nov. 25, 2026.
